data.title: Registered Nurse for Home Care
data.summary: The role provides nursing care in clients' homes, including health assessments, medication, care planning and documentation. It also involves cooperation with relatives, doctors and the wider care team.

requirements.text: Registration as a nurse with Valvira
At least 2 years of experience in home care
Finnish language skills at C1/C2 level
requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires advanced Finnish proficiency for this home care nursing role.

requirements.text: Independent and responsible approach to work
requirements.question: What does 'independent and responsible approach to work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for an independent and responsible approach without describing what this involves.
